_comment: Asset ids for textures uploaded by hand, before or outside the tool.
Open Cloud can't list what you own, so an id that never came from an upload has
to be written down somewhere — this is that somewhere. Entries here WIN over the
manifest, and a file whose block+face is covered here is NOT re-uploaded.
These mirror the hand-entered TEX table in src/Misc/Blocks.luau. Keep the two in
step: TEX is how a def gets an id, this is how the uploader knows to skip the file.
_seaLanternNote: SeaLantern is a THIRD-PARTY decal (creator 173613594, uploaded 2019), not ours.
Approved, so it exists — but asset-delivery returns 403 for it, and a decal id
you don't own is the one case where rbxassetid:// can resolve in Studio and not
at runtime. If the block renders blank in game, that's why: drop a sealantern.png
into the texture folder and re-run the uploader, same as every other block.
